member.name: T:MyMath.Operations
member.summary: Provides static methods for performing basic mathematical operations on integers.
member.remarks: The Operations class contains utility methods for fundamental arithmetic. All methods are static and can be called without creating an instance of the class.

member.name: M:MyMath.Operations.Add(System.Int32,System.Int32)

member.remarks: This method performs standard 32-bit integer addition. If the result overflows the range of , the behavior is undefined without checked context.
